objects: one object carrying one copied typed Devoid characteristic-definition fragment
state_reads: current copied keyword and typed ability-fragment characteristics
timing: the characteristic-defining effect applies continuously before non-CDA layer-5 effects
hidden_information: the definition reads no player-private state and projection does not expose typed fragments or physical IDs
layers: apply the CDA before later non-CDA color additions
layer-6 ability removal does not undo the already-applied layer-5 result
copy: layer-1 copied keyword and typed-fragment values determine whether the definition applies
control_change: controller identity does not affect the object-local definition
zone_change: the compiled fragment is evaluated in every represented zone
source_leaves: the definition belongs to the current object rather than a separate source

variants: colored mana costs with a colorless object
known_blockers: face-down producers until their layer-1 characteristic owner is trusted
aggregate copy, face, and continuous-effect dependencies remain incomplete
